## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Target `dev` for contributions, `staging` from `dev`, or `production` from `staging`.
- [ ] Add or update tests when behavior changes.
- [ ] Update documentation/examples for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Remove credentials and private data from code, configuration, and logs.
- [ ] Note compatibility changes, migration steps, or release limitations above.
